inventory_movement_gross_profit_diagnost.calculation: Subtract the negative movement-in-stockpiles-and-product-inventories cost line from reported costs applicable to sales, then subtract the adjusted cost from reported net sales. Q2 = H1 minus Q1.
limitations: This is an analytical reconciliation of an accounting line, not adjusted gross profit, cash cost, EBITDA or free cash flow.
It removes only the disclosed movement line and does not adjust royalty, deferred-stripping amortization, depreciation, by-product credits, or other cost components.
Do not treat carrying-value changes as physical concentrate volumes or assume this movement repeats in H2.

2026_amdal_scoping_notice.document_description: One-page issuer notice for preparation of the Elang AMDAL study, dated 21 September 2026; distributed for public input, not an approved AMDAL or final feasibility design.

context_comparators.interpretation: The 90 Mtpa figure is planned Elang ore mining capacity in the AMDAL notice; 85 Mtpa is expanded processing-plant annual ore capacity in the H1 presentation. These are different stages/definitions and are not forced into a single throughput assumption.

the approximately 60 km conveyor in this notice differs from the approximately 54 km OLC described in the March 2026 public presentation; route/scope difference is unresolved
this scoping notice does not show AMDAL approval or final design

development_status.forecast_implication: The FY2025 Annual Report disclosed an 85-90 Mtpa planned processing-plant expansion range; the H1 2026 presentation subsequently states 85 Mtpa, while the 21 September 2026 AMDAL scoping notice gives approximately 90 Mtpa as planned Elang ore-mining capacity. These are different dates/stages/definitions and are shown separately, not combined as one throughput assumption. The AMDAL notice also supplies initial infrastructure scope but no year-by-year processing, grade, recovery, saleable production, cost, capex or cash-flow schedule. Its roughly 60 km conveyor length differs from the roughly 54 km OLC in the March 2026 public presentation and remains unresolved. Completed FY2025 feasibility work plus ongoing optimization and mine planning still do not supply the annual asset-level FCFF schedule needed for NAV LoM.

hpm_concentrate_methodology.source_title: Keputusan Menteri ESDM Nomor 144.K/MB.01/MEM.B/2026 tentang perubahan Pedoman Penetapan Harga Patokan
hpm_concentrate_methodology.effective_period_note: Kepmen ditetapkan 10 April 2026; periode H1 mencakup masa sebelum dan sesudah perubahan pedoman.
hpm_concentrate_methodology.copper_concentrate_formula: HPM konsentrat = Cu grade × payable Cu × (HMA Cu − TC/RC Cu) + Au grade × payable Au × (HMA Au − RC Au) + Ag grade × payable Ag × (HMA Ag − RC Ag).
hpm_concentrate_methodology.published_payable_rules: Payable Cu maksimum 96.55% (dengan pengurang sesuai kadar); payable Au 97.0%–97.5% sesuai kadar; payable Ag hanya dihitung bila kadar sekurangnya 30 ppm, setelah pengurang 15 ppm.

hma_h1_2026.basis: Official ESDM HMA decree attachments, page 5; two periods per month. HMA determines statutory reference-price bands and is not AMMAN realized price or shipment HPM.
not_established: actual payable quantities and statutory base by product
actual royalty/export-duty expense allocation and tie-out to cash paid

royalty_and_export_duty.basis_and_limitation: The 12 official H1 2026 HMA periods have been mapped from ESDM decree attachments. They select the highest PP 19/2025 bands for copper concentrate (10%), cathode copper (7%), gold byproduct in concentrate (16%) and primary refined gold (16%). HMA is a statutory reference price, not shipment HPM or AMMAN realized price. H1 cash-flow line combines royalties, taxes and PNBP; product-specific reference-price bases/actual royalty allocation are not disclosed. Reported H1 realized prices are stated net of treatment/refining and prior-shipment mark-to-market adjustments, but do not specify treatment of royalties/export duty. Do not deduct statutory rates again from realized prices or apply rates to H2 until the actual accounting reconciliation is established.

other_financial_liabilities_usd_thousand.interpretation: Present-value lease and finance liabilities; current/noncurrent allocation.

contractual_undiscounted_long_term_loan_.interpretation: Undiscounted contractual cash flows, including principal and interest; maturity buckets are not a principal-only repayment schedule.

debt_and_contract_evidence.accrued_capex_interpretation: Balance-sheet accrual at June 30, 2026, not a forecast of remaining project capex or payment timing.

h1_bank_debt_cash_flows_usd_thousand.interpretation: Bank loan cash flow is proceeds less repayments across short and long term facilities; the restricted-cash cash-flow line reconciles net bank borrowing cash flow to total net financing cash flow in the statement. H1 presentation labels USD 588m debt repaid YTD, while the financial statement reports USD 580.866m exact long-term principal repayments; the USD 7.134m nominal difference is not bridged in the reviewed materials and the two headline bases are not confirmed to be identical. The presentation amount is rounded and should not replace the financial-statement cash-flow amounts. Does not include Q3 repayment or represent net debt balance change.

customer_delivery_commitment.delivery_commitment_until: 31 Desember 2027; dapat berlanjut sampai seluruh komitmen pengiriman dipenuhi atau uang muka pelanggan lunas
customer_delivery_commitment.settlement_mechanism: Monthly proportionate deductions from customer prepayment on cathode deliveries; failure to meet delivery commitment requires repayment of relevant prepayment plus interest.

provisional_pricing_evidence.revenue_recognition: Concentrate and copper cathode sales are initially recorded at 100% of provisional sales prices.
provisional_pricing_evidence.pre_settlement_measurement: Before final settlement, provisional prices are marked to market using forward prices for the estimated month of settlement; the embedded derivative is measured through profit or loss before final settlement.
provisional_pricing_evidence.quantity_adjustments: Provisional sales quantities may be adjusted when new metal quantity information and assay results are received.
provisional_pricing_evidence.contract_finalization: Substantially all copper and gold sales are provisionally priced at shipment and finalized in a future period specified in the contract; shipment-specific pricing periods are not disclosed in the cited note.
provisional_pricing_evidence.risk_disclosure: A significant price decline between provisional pricing and final settlement could require a return of part of proceeds received on provisional invoices. The company states a 2% copper/gold market-price decrease was unlikely to have a significant profitability effect at 30 June 2026, without disclosing a dollar sensitivity in this note.
missing_forecast_inputs: contractual pricing month and finalization date
payable metal and TC/RC terms by contract
forward metal curve for the settlement month
provisional receivable and embedded derivative balance by shipment/customer
provisional_pricing_evidence.forecast_implication: The Q2 implied net realized prices derived from rounded Q1/H1 weighted-average data are historical calibration estimates only. Future price assumptions must separately model shipment timing, provisional forward pricing, settlement terms, assay and payability; do not label the Q2 estimate a final realized price or confirmed H2 netback.

receivables_and_derivatives.classification_source_note: Note 2, printed page 29; Note 29, printed page 111
receivables_and_derivatives.interpretation: The accounting policy states that FVTPL financial assets include certain trade receivables from provisional copper or gold sales. Note 18 derivative asset/liability balances are itemized as interest-rate and cross-currency/principal-only swaps, not separate copper/gold price derivatives. FVTPL receivables are not split by product, customer, shipment, final pricing month or remaining provisional quantity. The fall in their balance is a point-in-time book-value change, not a standalone measure of H1 settlements, shipment volume or realized price.
limitations: Do not add Note 18 derivative assets to provisional metal receivables as if they were the same exposure.
No shipment-level provisional balance, forward curve, final price schedule or subsequent settlement reconciliation is disclosed.

elang_development_economics.fact: Studi kelayakan definitif Elang selesai pada 2025; FID ditargetkan 2027, bijih pertama 2031/2032, dan penambangan dimulai sesudah umur tambang Batu Hijau dan berlanjut hingga sekurangnya 2050. Capex pengembangan, jadwal produksi tahunan dan NPV studi kelayakan tidak diungkapkan.
elang_development_economics.valuation_consequence: Tanpa capex dan jadwal produksi, NAV Elang tidak dapat dihitung secara risk-adjusted; SOTP/LoM tetap tidak lengkap.
